title: The Song Describer Dataset: a Corpus of Audio Captions for Music-and-Language Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance on in-domain datasets (e.g., MusicCaps) versus a novel out-of-domain dataset (Song Describer Dataset) across music captioning, text-to-music generation, and music-text retrieval tasks to reveal overfitting and inflated in-distribution results.
